ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by tester. Sticky top-bar page title used `pathname.startsWith("${base}/${n.key}")` which incorrectly matched 'home' (first in NAV) for /parents/homework because /parents/home is a prefix of /parents/homework. Result: Homework page showed title 'Home'. Sidebar NavLink isActive was already correct (react-router exact), so highlighting was right — only the top-bar label was wrong. One-line fix applied: exact segment match (pathname === base/key || startsWith(base/key/)). Verified: /parents/home → 'Home', /parents/homework → 'Homework'. Student portal was unaffected (no colliding keys).

rca of the issue: Root cause: PortalShell.jsx line 18 computed `current` with `nav.find((n) => pathname.startsWith("${base}/${n.key}"))`. Because the parent NAV array starts with { key: 'home' } and 'home' is a lexical prefix of 'homework', visiting /parents/homework returned the 'home' entry (first match wins in Array.find), so the sticky top bar title read 'Home'. The sidebar NavLink isActive used react-router v6 which matches path segments exactly, so highlighting was correct; only the top-bar label was wrong. Fix: match exact segment via `pathname === ${base}/${n.key} || pathname.startsWith(${base}/${n.key}/)`. Student portal was immune because none of its NAV keys are prefixes of another (dashboard, timetable, homework, assignments, exams, results, attendance, notices, ai-tutor, library, fees, achievements, profile).
